name: session-marking
description: Bind a Codex or Claude Code session to an explicit target with configured destinations.

interface.shortDescription: Bind a session to one explicit target.
interface.longDescription: Mark the current Codex or Claude Code session, or supply its provider and session ID from a terminal. Save the binding locally and optionally project it through a configured host adapter.
interface.defaultPrompt: Mark this session using the target selection I provide.
